title: Thursday Daily Practice
subtitle: Listening: four map-labelling tasks under exam conditions
source: Daily Practice tuần 2 (print/I3/Daily_Practice_Week2_source.md), bài I3 Leisure and Recreation
intro: Work through 6 steps, about 70 minutes. You need 4 audio files (sent by the teacher on Zalo at 7:00). The maps for Steps 1 to 4 are in the Week 2 Daily Practice PDF (Thursday pages) and in the images folder. Listen to each file once, as in a real exam. Deadline 00:00 tonight. Complete and on time earns 20 Meow; late or half done earns 10 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

farm.label: Audio · Fiddy Farm (Cambridge 11, Test 1, Section 2, Q15–20)

rec.label: Audio · Recreation ground (Cambridge 16, Test 4, Part 2, Q15–20)

newb.label: Audio · Newbridge (Improve your IELTS, page 45, Track 1.28)

steps.title: Step 1 · Fiddy Farm
steps.instructions: Study the map for 1 minute (the picture in the PDF, or images/map_fiddy_farm.png). Start at 'You are here', next to New Barn. Listen once and choose letters A to I.

items.explain: Bằng chứng: in the corner beside the main path.
Bằng chứng: opposite the New Barn.
Bằng chứng: turn right just before the bridge, ở khúc cua đầu tiên. Bẫy: Café và Black Barn đều ở first bend nhưng đi từ hai đầu ngược nhau.
Bằng chứng: by the New Barn, where the path first bends.
Bằng chứng: just after you cross the bridge, on the right.
Bằng chứng: footpath to the left of the farmyard.

steps.title: Step 2 · Theatre
steps.instructions: Start in the foyer. Pay attention to the water cooler and the double doors (image: images/map_theatre.png). Listen once and choose letters A to G.

items.explain: Bằng chứng: next door, with a separate entrance from the road. Bẫy: box office không nằm ở chỗ công chúng nghĩ.
Bằng chứng: rẽ phải, end of the corridor, door on the left.
Bằng chứng: rẽ trái, rẽ phải ở water cooler, rẽ phải lần nữa, phòng thứ hai.
Bằng chứng: rẽ phải, the first room on the right-hand side.

steps.title: Step 3 · Recreation ground
steps.instructions: The map after the changes suggested in the recording (image: images/map_recreation_ground.png). Pay attention to compass directions and changes of plan. Listen once and choose letters A to I.

items.explain: Bằng chứng: opposite side of the hall, right next to it. Bẫy: xe hiện đỗ ở phía đông tòa nhà, bãi mới ở phía đối diện.
Bằng chứng: to the east, beyond the trees.
Bằng chứng: footpath from the hall, alongside the river.
Bằng chứng: in the southeast corner near the road.
Bằng chứng: to the left of the line of trees.
Bằng chứng: directly on people's right từ phía đường.

steps.title: Step 4 · Newbridge
steps.instructions: Start where you cross the bridge into High Street (image: images/map_newbridge.png). Example already done: A High Street. Listen once and choose letters A to H. A High Street · B tennis courts · C car park · D The Towers · E The Heights · F railway station · G town hall · H bus station.

items.explain: town hall ở next to the supermarket. Bẫy: future car park (C), old tennis courts (B).
railway station ở opposite the supermarket.
The Towers ở nearer the High Street. Bẫy: The Heights ở xa hơn (E).

steps.title: Step 5 · Trap tracker
steps.instructions: Write one sentence for each trap you fell into. If you did not fall into any trap, write one sentence about a place the speaker mentions that is not the answer, using the pattern: ... is wrong because ...

open.q: Câu về bẫy hoặc địa điểm bị loại
open.model: The Heights is wrong because the speaker says it is further from the High Street than The Towers.

steps.title: Step 6 · Reflection voice note
steps.instructions: Record a voice note of about 1 minute in English: which direction words helped you most today, and why.
lines: Which direction words helped you most today? Why?
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét cách dùng từ chỉ hướng và cách giải thích của em.

send_today: Hoàn thành 6 bước trên web, chụp ảnh các map đã điền gửi lên Zalo. Voice note ở Step 6 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
